approval_scope.carrying_piece: cold-core top lid, carried by back-bottom
approval_scope.flexible_spans: Illustrative. Exact intermediate bend positions, radii, straight lengths and displayed centerline lengths are not approved manufacturing constraints. Dress the actual tubes between the fixed interfaces and anchor stations.
approval_scope.retaining_detail: Seat and tie-passage geometry implements the selected anchor locations; those details do not fix the free tube spans.

construction: Two shallow paired seats integral with the cold-core lid. One common narrow zip tie per station passes through a transverse slot beneath the seat. Open mouths beside the tubes expose the slot for threading. The aft seat extends from the lid edge to support the outboard tube.
scope: Approved Reservoir A anchor and terminal locations with illustrative flexible spans. Native lid fusion and access cuts are supplied by the builder for production integration. Tie strips are nominal occupied-space witnesses, not purchased-part measurements.
